specs.title: judge journey: landing → guest → real 3D → 2D → independently saved local draft
no WebGL preserves real metadata, machine selection and source labels
failed metadata is an explicit error, never an infinite successful loader
failed GLB is recoverable through actual 2D fallback
keyboard, reduced motion, selection and theme changes keep static source truth
native 200% zoom keeps viewer navigation accessible
